coordinate_system.axis_evidence: The saved labels place Right at positive X and Front at positive Y. Z is the configured height. Physical compass heading and measurement origin are unverified.
coordinate_system.source_conversion: Original signed centimetres divided by 100; the stored positions above have no origin shift, rotation, mirroring, or rescaling.
coordinate_system.conversion: Subtract the chosen listener position in raw metres, rotate the resulting column vector by foa_from_raw_matrix, then normalize to a direction. Thus [x_foa,y_foa,z_foa]=[delta_Y,-delta_X,delta_Z]. The listener position is an independently declared assumption, not a surveyed value from this file.

source.kind: User-provided saved Yamaha project; current backup member

historical_difference.description: The earlier offline screen record placed Ceiling1 at Y=-1.25 m and Ceiling2 at Y=+1.25 m. This asset preserves the independently verified saved-file values: Ceiling1 at Y=+1.25 m and Ceiling2 at Y=-1.25 m.
